meta.name: semanticscholar-skill
meta.description: Use when searching academic papers, looking up citations, finding authors, or getting paper recommendations using the Semantic Scholar API. Triggers on queries about research papers, academic search, citation analysis, or literature discovery.

copy.tagline: 搜索学术论文、查找引用和作者
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文和引用信息
copy.tagline_en: Search academic papers, citations, and authors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers and citation information

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Semantic Scholar API 搜索学术论文、查找引用、获取作者信息或推荐相关文献。它会自动规划搜索策略，执行查询，并以表格或详细列表形式呈现结果。
howto.when: 当你询问学术论文、文献搜索、引用分析或作者信息时触发。例如，要求查找某篇论文、某位学者的著作或某主题的最新研究。

say.text: 帮我找一下关于‘干细胞’的最新论文。
say.note: Claude 会使用 bulk 搜索并返回结果。

say.text: Yann LeCun 在自监督学习方面有哪些论文？
say.note: Claude 会先搜索作者，再获取其论文并过滤主题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search academic papers, look up citations, find authors, or get paper recommendations using the Semantic Scholar API. It plans search strategies, executes queries, and presents results in tables or detailed lists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about academic papers, literature search, citation analysis, or author information. For example, requesting papers on a topic, an author's works, or recent research.

say_en.note: Claude will use bulk search and return results.

say_en.text: What papers did Yann LeCun publish on self-supervised learning?
say_en.note: Claude will search for the author, then get papers and filter by topic.
Claude will fetch citations and show intent labels.
